guidelines: Preserve the separation between a private rehearsal and public release publication.
Treat provider run metadata as evidence only when it is bound to the exact source SHA and requested tag.
Do not create, move, delete, or reuse a semantic-version tag.

intent.problem: The v0.5.48 candidate is prepared but has no source-bound provider rehearsal receipt. Releasing without a same-SHA rehearsal would violate the documented exact-source and private-rehearsal boundary.
constraints: Use the latest merged origin/main SHA and candidate tag v0.5.48.
Dispatch release.yml only with rehearsal=true; do not create a tag, GitHub Release, or public asset.
Do not modify candidate metadata or release source files during this evidence-only Work Item.
A later publication Work Item must independently authorize and verify public provider mutation.
intent.rationale: The rehearsal proves the authoritative workflow can prepare and validate the exact candidate source while keeping immutable publication actions out of the preparation Work Item.
